svg.title: The core flow, drawn as a delivery route. A sentence becomes an intent, a meal plan, scaled ingredients, real products with pack counts, an editable basket, then cart and checkout. Every step is real code. Intent, in intent.ts: reads dish, occasion, head count, budget, diet and constraints out of the sentence. Plan, in planner.ts: chooses the dishes, prices each candidate against the catalogue and spends the budget on the best menu that fits. Quantities, in recipes.ts and units.ts: per serving amounts scaled linearly, sub linearly or fixed, with unit conversion including per piece weights. Products, in matcher.ts: ranks catalogue products for each ingredient by key match, pack fit, waste, rating and price. Budget, in planner.ts: swaps to cheaper packs, then drops optional ingredients, then explains the shortfall honestly. Basket, in basket.ts: orchestrates the above and applies the shopper's swaps and removals.

section.h2: Six stops from a sentence to a basket
section.p: Every step is a real artefact in the codebase, not a prompt and print.

div.p: Reads dish, occasion, head count, budget, diet and constraints from the sentence.
Chooses the dishes, prices each candidate against the catalogue, spends the budget on the best menu that fits.
Per serving amounts scaled linear, sub linear or fixed. Converts units, including per piece weights.
Ranks real products for each ingredient by key match, pack fit, waste, rating and price.
Cheaper packs first, then drops optional ingredients, then explains any shortfall honestly.
Orchestrates it all and applies the shopper's swaps and removals.
